# RewardsPro customer account extension

[Module map](../README.md) · [Source directory](../../../apps/rewardspro/extensions/rewards-pro-membership)

Render membership and reward experiences inside Shopify customer accounts.

**Scope:** UI extension; its four gamification APIs are documented as unavailable until verified session identity is bound to shop and customer.

**Placement:** pnpm workspace member; package `rewardspro-membership`.

## Progress

Source review recorded **2026-09-28**. Extension configuration, localized UI and source are present. The README explicitly records 503 behavior for the unbound APIs.

This records source and documentation evidence. It does not establish deployment, external access, service health, or passing tests.

**Next review:** Resolve and test the documented authentication binding before enabling gamification API access; a bearer supplied by a client is insufficient evidence.
